thesis: A 78%-gross-margin, near net-cash outerwear brand with flat margins and rising FCF trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple, pricing only 3.1% growth after a tourism-driven flat quarter.
reason: Scorecard conviction 4: top-tier margins, near net-cash balance sheet and every multiple below its 5-year minimum, with the fall explained by a tourism and weather soft patch rather than margin damage. Python sizes it; cash is at the floor, so it replaces JKHY, a conviction-3 holding.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 75%, under the FY2021-25 range, signalling loss of brand pricing power.
TTM operating margin falls below 26%, under every year since FY2021, showing flat sales are deleveraging the cost base structurally.
TTM ROIC falls below 14%, extending the slide from 21.0% to 18.4% into clear moat erosion.
TTM FCF margin falls below 18%, under the FY2022 five-year low of 18.9%, showing inventory or working-capital stress from a weak season.

replacement_reason: Cash is at the 1.5% floor, so the buy needs funding; JKHY is held at conviction 3 and its price already implies growth above the company's framework, while Moncler scores conviction 4 at multiples below its own 5-year minimum.
